resolution: Same crash as req_1728 (the initial paste of the wgpu 'Dimension X value 10240 exceeds the limit of 8192' abort). Resolved by clamping oversized <Image> sources to the 8192 GPU texture limit via a bilinear downscale in framework/gpu/image_cache.zig before createTexture, so an over-limit image can never abort the app again. See req_1728 for the full fix paragraph; committed 4d3616b05, rebuilt ReleaseFast green.
